visualCharacteristics: A horizontal strip of tab buttons above a bordered content panel. The selected tab is highlighted and its panel is shown; other panels are hidden. Scrolls horizontally on narrow viewports.
contentPattern: One row per tab. Cell 1 = tab label (short text). Cell 2 = tab panel content (heading, paragraphs with bold lead-in subheadings, descriptions, and optional bullet lists / links).
usage: In-page tabbed content migrated from FedEx Custom Critical Owner Operators pages (Advantages: Programs / Communications / Online Tools; Overview / Advantages).
